note: lc6a-perlot-time-1123 (docs/336 §9, WRITTEN, NOT RUN; TIMING, needs quiet machine: Spotify, IDE and java closed, other CPU < 10%): deadrefperlot off vs on (deadrefdelta + deadrefslimuse ON in both arms, deadrefcadence ON; build lc6a1) in one load per world (BP / IP / SV). Run only after lc6a-perlot-correct-1123 passed. Smoke first. Each job: 25 min, 5-min slices, ABBA. Each on slice starts unseeded (the off arm drops the lists), so its first typed gather takes the snapshot and seeds: the on arm understates the gain. Read: node tools/harness/loopcost-report.ts --arm deadrefperlot <tag>-ab-fixes.jsonl (deadrefsweep phase 5-9 ms, deadrefcadence_snapshots per arm, deadrefperlot_gather_us); node tools/harness/hitch-ab.ts <tag>. Gate (docs/333 §6): no regression in our ms/s or hitch p99 / p99.9 / max beyond noise. Est ~1 h 50 min.
